result:
This matches upstream `pallets/click` PR #3504 exactly. Summary of the change:

- Reverted the broken `\n`-based fish field separator from #3126 back to `,`, and simplified the fish script's help-text branching (fish command substitution flattens real newlines, so the old separator scheme could never work).
- `FishComplete.format_completion` now emits `type,value` or `type,value\thelp` (per the Fish `complete` docs: comma-separated value, tab-separated description), escaping embedded `\n` as literal `\n` and collapsing `\t` to a space in help text.
- Updated `test_full_complete` fish expectations to the new `type,value\thelp` format and removed the now-obsolete `test_fish_multiline_help_complete` test (its assumption of a 3-line-per-item newline format no longer applies).

Verified with `uv run pytest tests -q`: 1562 passed, 93 skipped, 1 xfailed — the earlier failure I hit was from a stray globally-installed `click` package shadowing the repo's `src`, unrelated to this change.
